mcqs.question: At what repo rate did the Reserve Bank of India pause its rate-cut cycle in April 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The RBI paused the repo rate at 5.25% in April 2026, after cuts of about 125 basis points from early 2025. The tempting option 6.5% was the earlier repo rate reached between May 2022 and February 2023, not the April 2026 rate.

mcqs.question: In the context of the cost of bringing down inflation, what does the sacrifice ratio measure?
options: GDP lost per 1 percentage point fall in inflation
The percentage of crude oil imported by India
The repo-rate increase required to reduce inflation by 1 percentage point
The number of rate hikes undertaken by the US Federal Reserve
mcqs.explanation: The sacrifice ratio measures GDP lost per 1 percentage point fall in inflation. The option referring to crude oil imports describes India’s import dependence, while the other options do not define the sacrifice ratio.
